svg.aria-label: Security controls in place: Perimeter, Firewall and IDS: OPNsense filters traffic between the edge and the core; Suricata inspects it.; Perimeter, No inbound exposure: No port forwards, no VPN and no public services.; Network, Segmentation: Each role gets its own VLAN, including a storage VLAN for the NAS.; Network, Guest isolation: Guests reach the internet only; DHCP and DNS come from OPNsense.; Network, Camera isolation: No internet and no other VLANs; only the admin workstation can reach in.; Network, Storage access: Only Proxmox, the servers and the admin workstation can reach the NAS.; Access, Admin-only SSH: Network devices accept SSH only from the admin workstation.; Identity, Active Directory: Two domain controllers, a certificate authority and NPS for RADIUS.; Endpoints, Patching: WSUS manages Windows updates across the domain.; Monitoring, Logs and alerts: Wazuh and Splunk Free collect and search logs; LibreNMS watches every device.; Data, Backups: Servers and files back up to the UNAS Pro, off the R720's own drives.; Physical, Surveillance: Four PoE cameras on their own VLAN, recording to the NVR.; Publishing, Sanitized configs: Configs are cleaned before they're committed; no passwords or secrets here.
svg.title: Security controls
